commands.name: deb
commands.description: Create a Debian (.deb) installer for Debian and Ubuntu based distributions.

options.name: --output
options.description: Destination path for the generated .deb file

options.name: --summary
options.description: Summary. Short description that should not end in a dot.

options.name: --appId
options.description: Application Id. Usually a Reverse DNS name like com.SomeCompany.SomeApplication

options.name: --is-terminal
options.description: Indicates whether your application is a terminal application [default: False]

options.name: --service
options.description: Install as a systemd service/daemon [default: False]

options.name: --service-type
options.description: systemd service type: simple (default), notify, forking, oneshot

options.name: --service-restart
options.description: Restart policy: on-failure (default), always, no, on-abnormal, on-abort

options.name: --service-user
options.description: User to run the service as
